independent_control_EP.name: E-P: ordinary early output assignment, short translation pin, and checked source no-fill fallback
independent_control_EP.independence: This control fixes concrete destinations before source READ rather than evaluating matching rank at every source fill. It does not receive the candidate's per-fill rank predicate. Ordinary output assignment and pinning are the components; the complete COPY_TO_SET integration here is a constructed control, not claimed to be a published complete algorithm.
independent_control_EP.original_start: Use the same two submitted parents, immutable allowed sets, actual FREE-hot X/Y, registered pinned common context, source addresses outside the pool, and co-live output leases. Admit both legally before any of their READ children. No artificial cache/permission snapshot and no inheritance of a candidate-created blocked state. The sample still is a hand construction, not a trace recorded from the native RTL.
algorithm: ADMIT: apply the same paid full-FREE feasibility admission and payload/completion reservations. When these two parents are actually present, ordinary most-constrained-first selection gives A->Y, V->X. For arbitrary sets use ordinary complete matching; do not pretend the two-job heuristic is universally complete.

Atomically lease those two actual slots and record their fixed identity before generating source READ children. The pool/allowed-set contract permits legal early BIND in this sample; no ready early BIND is held back. If source-read-first is a mandatory semantic constraint in a future workload, this particular control is inapplicable there and must not be imposed.

Find each selected translation in the actual resident index, validate exact context/epoch association, and protect at least one correct resident row per selected slot. Pinning does not grant write permission or synthesize a cache access/history touch.

At a successful necessary source walk, do the complete normal permission and original-owner processing. Ordinary PLRU chooses from actual allocation_mask minus protected rows. If empty, deliver the checked translation result to the unchanged original source request without shared fill, using the same paid continuation required by L-M.

Perform real source AR/R and the same payload buffering, then normal WRITE translation for the already-selected slot. Keep its pin until successful WRITE translation is accepted by the immutable physical request header. AW/W/B, completion, cache sync and consumer release remain real and paid.

Faults and cancellation retain the original phase-specific drain/quarantine contract. No published VALID request is altered. Invalidation or epoch uncertainty drops the performance guarantee and invokes the normal legal cold/fault path. Pin is advisory, bounded and can yield under the same fairness override as L-M.

fields_and_logic.common: The new COPY_TO_SET contract, actual allowed-set/ownership registration, full-FREE assignment admission, two protected lifecycles, payload/completion capacity, real permissions, resident/context index and checked original-result continuation must be paid by both methods. None exists for free simply because the native design has four iDMAs or eight AX headers.
fields_and_logic.bound_field_lifetime: E-P writes the actual early-bound slot into each ordinary bound-slot6 field. It retains that field through the same ownership/completion lifetime; it is not simultaneously reused for an unrelated candidate or result. Two explicit pin-valid flags avoid assuming free phase encoding.
fields_and_logic.named_example: Using round04's same illustrative 146-bit two-parent records and 158-bit original-result continuation: E-P adds two pin-valid bits, for 306 named bits. L-M's illustrative three 5-bit rank counters instead gave 319. If the same new 160-bit resident sidecar is needed, these named subsets are 466 and 479. This 13-bit difference is not a complete area or timing result.
fields_and_logic.missing_costs: Dynamic mask generation/serialization, any registered 16-bit mask and version, matching/slot allocation ports, pin release, context/error routing, parent/driver software, pin lookup latency and external allocation guards are charged. A registered mask or epoch pipeline is extra for whichever implementation uses it. E-P can move selection earlier and hold leases longer; that can hurt other workloads. No LUT, Fmax, complete storage or V/A superiority is asserted.

decisive_sample.input: V allowed={X,Y}; A allowed={Y}; exactly X,Y are hot eligible output slots, both parents require distinct co-live outputs and are present at legal admission. E=16 remains available; use the actual policy mask, not a forced two-way global cache.
decisive_sample.assignments: The full two-hot assignment is uniquely V->X,A->Y. E-P assigns it at admission; L-M must preserve these same two distinct slots through source fills and later assign them.
decisive_sample.victim_set_proof: With unique resident X and Y rows, removing either decreases matching rank from 2 to 1. Every allowed other-row victim preserves rank 2. Thus L-M safe_mask and E-P allocation_mask-minus-pin_mask are identical in this sample. If an allowed nonoutput row exists, both can fill the same preferred ordinary victim. If only protected rows are allowed, both take their paid checked no-fill route. This does not assume disabling the other 14 native ways.
decisive_sample.completion_ledger: Both perform the same actual two source translations, two source AR/R transfers, two ordinary WRITE permission checks, two AW/W/B transfers, completion records and required join/release. Neither causes the displayed extra cold destination walk. Pin lookup itself is not an early permission grant or an extra fake WRITE.
decisive_sample.quantitative_judgment: The previous M=20,delta=3 sketch compared preservation with an unsafe eviction. Against E-P, the alleged saved extra output-walk count is 0: both avoid it. No new 17-unit win can be attributed to L-M over this control. Complete control/candidate decision delays and costs are still unmeasured.
decisive_sample.limits: This proves replication of the stated static-overlap boundary and its PTE benefit under the listed sample conditions. It does not prove equal elapsed cycles on native RTL or equivalence across dynamic releases, arrivals, duplicates, multiple contexts or future source reuse.

alternative_BP.name: B-P: keep one witness assignment and protect its resident representatives until a real obligation event
alternative_BP.constructive_rule: At admission/release/eligibility/pool-fill events, use the ordinary full-FREE allocator to choose a complete assignment maximizing currently hot outputs. Store an advisory hot basis; it is not a granted lease. On a source fill outside the pool, evict only rows outside one representative for each basis slot, else use the same normal checked no-fill route. Update ownership/obligations atomically; retain bound singletons through accepted WRITE translation.
alternative_BP.invariant: If all r hot slots of that assignment remain resident and eligible, the recorded assignment still supplies r hot outputs. Removing an unprotected row cannot reduce r(H) below r. This is standard matching witness reasoning, not a new theorem.
alternative_BP.distinction: With redundant hot choices, a fixed basis may block a source fill that L-M could allow by changing the basis. Recomputing a victim-compatible basis on every fill simply supplies the proposed set-aware decision through another representation. Therefore B-P is a useful alternative implementation/control to evaluate, not evidence that the entire set-valued contract was published, nor a universal trace-equivalence proof.
alternative_BP.acceptance: Do not demand that L-M beat its own information/action compiled into a witness-pin implementation. The independent E-P baseline is the concrete rejection of the current static sample; dynamic contract value and a full-cost frontier remain hypotheses.

adjacent_boundary.legitimate_open_case: A required late semantic eligibility change or true source-dependent destination choice can make early fixed assignment inappropriate. Extra alternative hot slots can allow rank-preserving replacement that a fixed pin basis blocks. Such a case could distinguish L-M from E-P/B-P without forcing delay on a ready baseline.
adjacent_boundary.missing: No original native COPY/consumer trace yet establishes this condition, no complete paid control comparison yields independent joint V/A benefit, and no new complete-cost advantage is derived here.
adjacent_boundary.future_source_reuse: Protecting a matching may increase source misses; PTE savings or occupancy alone cannot replace useful joint throughput, fairness and tail latency.
adjacent_boundary.innovation_if: If a real original-start condition requires choices to remain unresolved, the set-aware rule yields useful joint V/A or a complete implementation-cost frontier that executable independent controls cannot reproduce at the same budget, and closest primary work does not cover that action/contract, then the integrated mechanism can form an independent contribution.

primary_scope.title: Scalable and Efficient Virtual Memory Sharing in Heterogeneous SoCs with TLB Prefetching and MMU-Aware DMA Engine
primary_scope.direct_evidence: Section IV-C, PDF page 6 (zero-based page5), parsed lines596-611 explicitly describes the earlier design's locking all translations before programming a transfer and releasing locks after completion, and discusses its concurrency cost. This supports pinning-before-DMA as an old component. It does not cover the exact COPY_TO_SET matching-admission contract; that full claim remains separately unresolved.

direct_source_review.fact: Native dynamic policy allocation mask and masked tree-PLRU are present. Neither new live pins nor matching guard nor checked no-fill completion should be described as already implemented.
Normal PT success still depends on fill followed by an IOTLB hit. Both L-M and a pin control need an explicit successful checked-result continuation; suppressing fill alone is incomplete.

root_judgment.rule_newness: The set-valued COPY integration is a hypothesis; component pinning and matching are old. The constructed control is not a paper citation or a first-invention disproof.
root_judgment.exclusive_benefit: Because an executable ordinary early assignment+pin control reproduces the static positive sample's saved destination walk, that sample cannot support independent faster-algorithm benefit. This round adds a sharper control, not a new supported independent gain.
root_judgment.engineering: A restricted implementation is plausible but unimplemented and incompletely costed. Current software/RTL cannot be presented as having passed the proposed new contract.
root_judgment.action: After the bounded L-W review, if it likewise provides no new supported independent contribution, pause exploration under the user's condition; preserve hypotheses and the one specific missing evidence condition. Do not expand another route or start a model/build merely to keep working.
